title: The cerebellum does not contribute to consciousness

statements.text: The cerebellum has several times more neurons than the cerebral cortex but does not contribute to consciousness, because its modular organization yields low integrated information.

sources.quote: why the cerebral cortex gives rise to consciousness but the cerebellum does not, though it has even more neurons and appears to be just as complicated.
Intriguingly, a brain region such as the cerebellum, whose anatomical organization is highly modular, does not contribute to consciousness [44, 45]
